The flag is not cosmetic: RelicModel.IsTradable returns false for any HasUponPickupEffect relic (RelicModel.cs:176-190) and relics/base.py:126-136 mirrors that, so dropping it would make a spent relic tradable. AfterObtained.issue: Rollup of guard G1 per binding rule 4. The relic's OWN halves are all faithful -- the candidate filter (N1, executed: zero disagreements over 203 ported cards), the count of 1, and the enchantment identity -- but the Imbued enchantment the relic grants behaves differently in the sim, and Electric Shrymp is the only ported grantor of Imbued, so the relic's observable effect diverges in every run that takes it.

guards.what: G1 (LIVE): the Imbued enchantment this relic grants auto-plays on turn 1 ALWAYS in C# and only ~47% of the time in the sim
guards.issue: MECHANISM: Imbued.cs:20-26's AfterAutoPrePlayPhaseEntered calls CardCmd.AutoPlay(ctx, base.Card, null) unconditionally while TurnNumber <= 1 -- it does not care which pile the card is in, and Imbued.cs:11's ShouldStartAtBottomOfDrawPile guarantees the card is at the BOTTOM of the draw pile because CombatManager.cs:657-672 runs that pile move before the turn-1 draw. The sim's port fires from on_player_turn_started and requires `self.card in player.hand` (enchantments.py:261-267), and never bottoms the card -- its own docstring calls ShouldStartAtBottomOfDrawPile 'cosmetic' (enchantments.py:249). REACHABILITY (LIVE, executed -- py audit/tools/relic_probes_b05.py shrymp-imbued): over 200 seeds, `run.add_relic('electric_shrymp')` then a combat auto-plays the Imbued card on turn 1 in 94 seeds (47%) and leaves it unplayed in the other 106, where C# plays it in all 200. Both sides ported: the relic is granted by the ported Orobas shrine (events/orobas.py:20, OPTION_POOL_1) and the sim's only Skill in the starting deck is Defend, so the enchant target always exists (executed: enchanted card = ('defend', 'Imbued')). The missing pile move is audit/records/seam/turn_structure.json G14, which that record already labels LIVE and whose reachability witness is THIS relic -- one verdict per mechanism, binding rule 3; the seam owns the turn-1 pile pass, the enchantment stream owns Imbued's own hook choice, and this record owns the relic's observable. NOTE per binding rule 7: this rationale leans on Imbued.cs, CombatManager.cs and sts2_rl/enchantments.py, NONE of which this record hashes.

guards.what: N1: C# selects through CardSelectCmd.FromDeckForEnchantment (ElectricShrymp.cs:23) and the sim pre-filters the deck with ImbuedEnchantment.can_enchant (electric_shrymp.py:19)
guards.rationale: SETTLED BY EXECUTION, and it settles the open question relic/beautiful_bracelet's guard G1 left flagged for the Swift case. CardSelectCmd.cs:549 shows the command's filter is EXACTLY `enchantment.CanEnchant(c) && (additionalFilter?.Invoke(c) ?? true)` with additionalFilter null here -- there is no extra pile-level exclusion (the Quest exclusion beautiful_bracelet worried about belongs to FromDeckForTransformation, not this path). EnchantmentModel.CanEnchant (EnchantmentModel.cs:273-294) rejects CardType 4/5/6 = Status/Curse/Quest (CardType.cs:3-12), then CanEnchantCardType, then a deck-pile Unplayable card, then any existing enchantment when the enchantment is not IsStackable; Imbued.cs:15-18 adds `cardType == Skill`. The sim's predicate is enchantments.py:52-61 plus ImbuedEnchantment.can_enchant (enchantments.py:255-259). `py audit/tools/relic_probes_b05.py shrymp-imbued` evaluates both predicates over all 203 ported cards and reports 0 disagreements. Rule 7: CardSelectCmd.cs, EnchantmentModel.cs, Imbued.cs, CardType.cs and enchantments.py are unhashed here.

guards.what: N2: `if (cards.Count <= prefs.MinSelect) enumerable = cards;` (CardSelectCmd.cs:576-578) -- C# auto-keeps when the candidate list is no bigger than the ask; the sim always routes through run.select_cards
guards.rationale: run.select_cards (run.py:371-390) clamps `count = min(count, len(candidates))` and returns [] for an empty candidate list, so with MinSelect 1 the two agree on both edges: 0 candidates -> nothing enchanted, 1 candidate -> that card enchanted. Rule 7: CardSelectCmd.cs and run.py are unhashed here.

guards.what: N3: run.select_cards falls back to `self.rng.sample` when no card_selector is installed (run.py:381-390), where C# opens a player-choice screen and draws no RNG at all
guards.issue: PROMPT.md bug class 16's second half at an out-of-combat site: C#'s FromDeckForEnchantment consumes no Rng (CardSelectCmd.cs:580-602 is a UI/remote-choice branch), so the sim's default random pick both chooses differently AND advances the shared legacy random.Random, shifting every later draw off it. DORMANT for RL play (a policy is free to pick any eligible card) and dormant for the conformance harness (the runner installs run.card_selector from the replay's SelectGridCard commands, so the fallback is not taken); it goes live for any parity run that reaches this relic with no selector installed. Recorded rather than waived because 'the sim substitutes a random pick for a player choice' is a divergence in shape, not merely in today's content (binding rule 1). Rule 7: run.py is unhashed here.

guards.what: N4: CardCmd.Enchant(canonicalMomentum.ToMutable(), item, 1m) passes an AMOUNT of 1 (ElectricShrymp.cs:25); the sim's make_enchantment('imbued').attach(card) passes none (electric_shrymp.py:21)
guards.rationale: Imbued.cs:13 declares ShowAmount => false and Imbued's behaviour (AfterAutoPrePlayPhaseEntered, Imbued.cs:20-26) never reads the amount, so the 1 is display-only for this enchantment. Contrast relic/beautiful_bracelet, whose Swift amount of 3 IS load-bearing and which the sim therefore carries as a constant. Rule 7: Imbued.cs is unhashed here.

guards.what: N5: CardCmd.Preview(item) and the Imbued ExtraHoverTips (ElectricShrymp.cs:17, 26)
guards.rationale: RelicModel.Flash() / base.Status = RelicStatus.* / ShowCounter / DisplayAmount / InvokeDisplayAmountChanged / CanonicalVars / ExtraHoverTips / Cmd.Wait / VfxCmd / CardCmd.Preview are presentation only -- the relic bar's glow, counter and hover text, the damage/heal numbers and animation timing. The sim has no relic UI. Waived under the shared contract's presentation/animation exclusion, not under an unreachability claim.
